[quote=the_crystalline_empire;58822322][b]2025: A shifting world[/b]
The pride of Thýven's staunchest nationalists had been deeply injured after the government bended to ensure peace in the white sea by giving austmark to New Albany. They had strongly opposed after which any attempt to make deals with the nation or its states, blocking any parliamentary moves which would permit the moving forward of any deal or diplomacy. However, as the world rapidly shifted towards a very clear wartorn era, and with expansions by Sikirsk to the West, concerns within the old guard of the parliament and government were voiced. As a result the government would permit foreign minister Alja Engta to send note to the High Alban government regarding a potential deal to have New Albany act as a satellite ally state to THEP.

[nation]Norrhollow[/nation][/quote]
[b]Make war, not love | [sub]Kingsmount, High Albany | 18 March 2025[/sub][/b]

"I'll be frank here, Mr. Stillebrann." Minister of Foreign Affairs Alice Ostman began, stroking her hair as she stood up from her seat. "I can see no greater indignity in the affairs of this Commonwealth that could possibly be worse than listening what Thrømm have to say."

The Albic committee murmured silently to themselves, some nodding along in agreement, some blank and indifferent, others hissing silently as they looked to Mors Stillebrann for counter. But the Minister of Environment made no response, not yet at least, instead crossing his arms as he remained in his seat, looking up at Ostman as he waited, wondering if Ostman had already spoken her peace. As he would have correctly guessed, she had not.

"It's an impressive alliance on paper, sure..." Ostman continued. "But it simply does not have the mettle to challenge the great powers of Erene. The simple fact that a nation as unreliable as Thýven is in it should be more than enough of a dealbreaker, Mr. Stillebrann. I understand that the Norrhollower people have this strange sort of cultural affinity for their old fatherland, but open your eyes already. We aren't Thýven, we're High Albany. We resolve to do what is good for Kingsmount and all the people of the Commonwealth, not just you and your antler-laden pals over in Stormhaven."

[list]

"Antler-laden pals, that's a new one..." Stillebrann chuckled, adjusting his glasses, speaking at last after several minutes of quiet hearkening. "Look Minister Ostman, you and I both know that High Albany cannot stand alone forever."

"And I never suggested that we should."

[/list]

"THEP is our biggest way out of this. High Albany alone is more powerful than all of these states combined. We are a ferocious people, with great resources and military capabilities, with corporations spanning from the western wastes of the Transalbic to the sands of the Eastern Baliwick. You concern yourself with needless worries that THEP will somehow strive to bring High Albany down and to enslave its people to its international mandate, but will it really be able to? With what army?"

"The fact that you belittle anything less than Monad is why you manage the Environment, Mr. Stillebrann, not Foreign Affairs." Ostman angrily retorted. "THEP is organized. It is very organized, especially when compared with all these other random and lackadaisical organizations you have skittering around Erene nowadays. They're not just a defensive compact, they're a proper military alliance capable of organizing and reorganizing its resources to defeat a common enemy. Even with High Albany's power, we cannot try to challenge the majority voices in THEP's council."

[list]

"... Right, looks like we're deadset in our ways, Ms. Ostman." Stillebrann would bemoan, clearly unimpressed by Ostman's points even until now. "Have you any alternatives then, if you really do not want High Albany to finally break out of its isolationist cage for once?"

"As a matter of fact, I do, Mr. Stllebrann... you may even be familiar with it already..." Ostman remarked, smirking ever so slightly. "Have you ever considered an alliance based here in Kingsmount, but whose very words will be capable of swaying nations all across the White Sea?"

[/list]

The committee held its breath.

[b]Concerning other matters[/b]

The Albic Ministry of Foreign Affairs would firmly reject any proposals to bring the Commonwealth of High Albany into the orbit of THEP, highlighting that the present geopolitical conflicts gripping that alliance do not resonate with the current interests of the Commonwealth. However, Minister Ostman would invite the Thrømm to meet the Albics at a special summit in Kingsmount to discuss alternative proposals that [i]"... may be of similar and congruent interest to Tharkønn."[/i]
